# VYRAL

> VYRAL is a LinkedIn analytics tool and AI writing coach. It reads the numbers on your own posts, shows what worked, and drafts your next post from it. Built on LinkedIn's official API.

Key facts:
- Built on LinkedIn's official API.
- VYRAL connects your LinkedIn strategy (the Blueprint), your posts and your results in one place.
- VYRAL never scrapes, never adds anything to your browser, and never automates likes, comments or connection requests.
- Plans: Creator at $49 a month, or $39 a month billed yearly. Pro at $99 a month, or $79 a month billed yearly. Business is for companies and teams, set up with us: everything in Pro plus one LinkedIn company page. Talk to us for pricing. Every plan is paid; the trial is the only free access.
- Every account starts with 14 days of Pro, including 50 AI runs. No credit card.
- Creator includes 250 AI runs a month. Pro is unlimited. Fair use: up to 500 AI runs a day on every plan.
- If a trial ends or payment stops, the account keeps read-only access to its existing history. Nothing new syncs and paid features are unavailable.
- The app runs at app.getvyral.io.
- Founder: Vicky Salunova (https://www.linkedin.com/in/vicky-salunova/)

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.getvyral.io): What VYRAL does
- [How VYRAL works](https://www.getvyral.io/how-vyral-works): Connecting LinkedIn, publishing and how the numbers sync
- [LinkedIn analytics](https://www.getvyral.io/linkedin-analytics): Post analytics, patterns, timing and reports
- [AI Coach](https://www.getvyral.io/ai-coach): Drafts in your voice, draft scoring and ideas from your own posts
- [LinkedIn content strategy](https://www.getvyral.io/linkedin-content-strategy): The Blueprint, the content calendar and pillar alignment
- [Use cases](https://www.getvyral.io/solutions): How creators, ghostwriters and agencies use VYRAL
- [Official API](https://www.getvyral.io/linkedin-tool-safe): How VYRAL connects to LinkedIn, and what it never does
- [Pricing](https://www.getvyral.io/pricing): Plans, the trial and a feature comparison
- [Sign up](https://app.getvyral.io/auth?mode=signup): Start the 14-day trial
